_comment: Chance per action that a combat ability goes up by one (owner's rules, 2026-10-14). A skill cast trains the ability on the skill (Ranged Combat, Nature Magic, Fire Magic...); an auto-attack that lands trains the weapon's ability (Bow, Sword, Totem...); a critical hit trains Critical Strike or Critical Skills. Abilities still stop at the cap (twice the character's level + 5, at most 500). Restart the server after editing.
